method: Manually curated from cited primary articles, reporting aggregated public evidence only. No IPD access claimed.

studies.name: Jacobsen et al 2026 exploratory dose-response stromal histology
studies.observed_short_term_interval: 4-6 weeks after session five; no 3/6/12-month biopsy
limitations: No sham group; early follow-up
Different left/right vaginal biopsy sides
Epithelium thickness not quantifiable due to section orientation
No independent subject-level data in pipeline

studies.name: Gaspar et al 2017 Er:YAG vs estriol qualitative long-follow-up biopsy
studies.observed_short_term_interval: Biopsies 1,3,6,12 months post-treatment, 6 people per intervention group

published_results.biopsy_endpoints: Qualitative H&E morphology; no reproducible numeric ECM architecture per person

studies.correspondence: author listed in Wiley; address should be manually reconfirmed
limitations: Prospective comparator is estriol, no sham
Laser arm received estriol pre-treatment
Histological effects chiefly qualitative
12-month source labels are post-treatment but original patient visit times unavailable

studies.name: LIGHT sham randomized cohort and 2026 12-month companion followup, same cohort
studies.observed_short_term_interval: 6 month visit 1 month after fifth laser/sham session; 12-month followup (about 7 months off intervention) no repeat quantifiable epithelial biopsies
studies.correspondence: Eduard Mension, Hospital Clínic Barcelona; institution-listed email needs independent extraction
limitations: Follow-up JAMA 2026 is SAME cohort, not independent
No 3,6,12-month structural biopsy after last dose
Other first-line nonhormonal therapies concurrently used
Elasticity change is AFM material stiffness, not collagen microarchitecture

studies.name: Li randomized sham laser with 46 paired biopsies and histology report
studies.observed_short_term_interval: Histology measured six months AFTER FIRST session; duration from last session not independently verified
limitations: No statistically significant histological difference
6 months after FIRST treatment not 6 months after LAST treatment
Histological classes not directly quantitative collagen/elastin
2021 and 2023 are same trial family

studies.name: Human vaginal biopsies pre/post 3 months transdermal estradiol, expression only
studies.observed_short_term_interval: Biopsy last day of treatment, no followup post-cessation
studies.correspondence: NCBI GEO accession with authors' contact
limitations: Public microarray not histomorphometry
No cessation
Raw sample pairing not confirmed in current environment
Rodent samples also present in GEO family
